Chimpanzees Are Living Better Than Us! Wild chimpanzees are casually consuming the equivalent of two cocktails a day thanks to fermented fruit.
Which honestly explains a lot.

They can grab things with their toes, bite people’s faces off, and now we find out they’re getting lightly buzzed on a regular basis. Yet another reason everyone secretly wants to be a chimpanzee.
